Welcome to my website! My name is Luke Simon, and I am from Napa, California. Currently, I am an undergraduate at UCSB pursuing degrees in both hydrology and English, which I plan on completing in June of 2028. Outside of classes, I am the lead production coordinator for the AS Program Board, where I produce on-campus concerts and act as the head audio engineer. This website will act as a space for me to document my personal and academic adventures.
